metadata.description: Retail Reason provides connected expertise for Walmart suppliers, Sam's Club suppliers, Marketplace sellers, and their advisors. This marketplace installs the client plugin for Claude Code and Cowork. An eligible Retail Reason account with active access is required.

plugins.name: retail-reason
plugins.description: Retail Reason helps Walmart suppliers, Sam's Club suppliers, Marketplace sellers, and their advisors answer operating questions and review draft plans. Covers supplier operations, Scintilla reporting, Marketplace selling, and Supplier One, with glossary and fiscal-calendar tools. Claude Code uses a personal access key; Cowork uses Retail Reason account sign-in. Active account access is required.
